events.summary: Validate and sharpen the innovation claim for a public technical post that introduces the Octocode research platform before Octocode Awareness

Local docs support a two-plane story: Octocode establishes code truth through one MCP/CLI research engine; Awareness regulates continuity and coordination around that evidence. External scan shows shared memory, task graphs, claims, and agent mailboxes are crowded categories, so novelty must be framed as integration, not invention.
